/* M165: CMS worktree plumbing with staged multi-path tree rewrites. */
address cms
parse arg command rest
command=translate(command)
objectfm='A'
'STATE GITMETA REPO A'
if rc=0 then do
 drop cfg.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITMETA REPO A 1 (STEM CFG. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 | cfg.0<4 | cfg.1\='CMS-GIT-REPOSITORY 1' then do
  say 'GITWT: invalid repository metadata'
  exit 8
 end
 objectrecords=0
 do ci=1 to cfg.0
  if word(cfg.ci,1)='OBJECT-DISK' then do
   if words(cfg.ci)\=2 then exit 8
   objectrecords=objectrecords+1
   objectfm=translate(word(cfg.ci,2))
  end
 end
 if objectrecords>1 | length(objectfm)\=1 |,
    verify(objectfm,'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ')\=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: invalid OBJECT-DISK setting'
  exit 8
 end
end
else if rc\=28 then exit 8

if command='CHECKOUT' then do
 wc=words(rest)
 if wc<4 | wc>5 then do
  say 'Usage: GITWT CHECKOUT ref path fn ft [fm]'
  exit 4
 end
 spec=word(rest,1)
 path=word(rest,2)
 fn=translate(word(rest,3))
 ft=translate(word(rest,4))
 if wc=5 then fm=translate(word(rest,5))
 else fm='A'
 checkoutfn=fn
 checkoutft=ft
 checkoutfm=fm
 call validid fn
 if result\='OK' then exit 4
 call validid ft
 if result\='OK' then exit 4
 call validmode fm
 if result\='OK' then exit 4
 call toasciihex path
 pathhex=result
 if pathhex='ERROR' | length(pathhex)>60 then do
  say 'GITWT: M164 path must be 1-30 ASCII bytes'
  exit 4
 end
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 call findpath pathhex
 pi=result
 if pi>0 then do
  if mapfn.pi\=fn | mapft.pi\=ft | mapfm.pi\=fm then do
   say 'GITWT: path already mapped to another CMS file'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 call findfile fn,ft,fm
 fi=result
 if fi>0 & fi\=pi then do
  say 'GITWT: CMS file already mapped to another Git path'
  exit 8
 end
 'STATE' fn ft fm
 if rc=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: checkout target exists; M164 refuses overwrite'
  exit 8
 end
 if rc\=28 then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot inspect checkout target RC' rc
  exit 8
 end
 call readrefs
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 call resolve spec
 oid=result
 if oid='ERROR' then exit 8
 call bindnative
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 call pathoidfor oid,pathhex
 pathoid=result
 fn=checkoutfn
 ft=checkoutft
 fm=checkoutfm
 if pathoid='ERROR' then do
  say 'GITWT: checkout source could not be read' path
  exit 8
 end
 call bodyrecords body
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 call writework fn,ft,fm
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 call workoid fn,ft,fm,final,0
 wo=result
 if wo\=pathoid then do
  'ERASE' fn ft fm
  say 'GITWT: workfile round-trip OID mismatch'
  exit 8
 end
 if pi=0 then do
  if mapcount>=50 then do
   'ERASE' fn ft fm
   say 'GITWT: worktree map limit reached'
   exit 8
  end
  mapcount=mapcount+1
  pi=mapcount
 end
 mapfn.pi=fn
 mapft.pi=ft
 mapfm.pi=fm
 maplf.pi=final
 mapbase.pi=pathoid
 mapstage.pi=pathoid
 mappath.pi=pathhex
 call savemap
 if result\='OK' then do
  'ERASE' fn ft fm
  exit 8
 end
 say 'CHECKED OUT' path 'AS' fn ft fm
 say 'WORKTREE OID' pathoid 'FINAL-LF' final
 exit 0
end

if command='CHECKOUT-TREE' then do
 if words(rest)\=1 then do
  say 'Usage: GITWT CHECKOUT-TREE ref'
  exit 4
 end
 spec=word(rest,1)
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot read worktree map'
  exit 8
 end
 call readrefs
 if result\='OK' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot read refs'
  exit 8
 end
 call resolve spec
 treecommit=result
 if treecommit='ERROR' then exit 8
 call bindnative
 if result\='OK' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot bind native object reader'
  exit 8
 end
 call rootfor treecommit
 treeroot=result
 if treeroot='ERROR' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot read checkout root tree'
  exit 8
 end
 call readtree treeroot,''
 if result\='OK' & result\='MISSING' then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot validate checkout root tree'
  exit 8
 end
 treefiles=ecount
 if treefiles=0 then do
  say 'CHECKED OUT EMPTY TREE' treecommit
  exit 0
 end
 if treefiles>50 | mapcount+treefiles>50 then do
  say 'GITWT: checkout exceeds 50 mapped workfiles'
  exit 8
 end
 drop tfn. tft. tpath. toid. tlf. treccount. trecord.
 do ti=1 to treefiles
  if emode.ti\='100644' then do
   say 'GITWT: tree checkout supports flat regular files only'
   exit 8
  end
  call asciitocms ename.ti
  tpath.ti=result
  if tpath.ti='ERROR' | pos('/',tpath.ti)>0 then do
   say 'GITWT: invalid or nested checkout path'
   exit 8
  end
  dotpos=pos('.',tpath.ti)
  if dotpos=0 then do
   tfn.ti=translate(tpath.ti)
   tft.ti='TEXT'
  end
  else do
   if dotpos=1 | dotpos=length(tpath.ti) |,
      pos('.',substr(tpath.ti,dotpos+1))>0 then do
    say 'GITWT: path needs one simple CMS filename extension'
    exit 8
   end
   tfn.ti=translate(left(tpath.ti,dotpos-1))
   tft.ti=translate(substr(tpath.ti,dotpos+1))
  end
  call validid tfn.ti
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: path cannot map to a CMS filename' tpath.ti
   exit 8
  end
  call validid tft.ti
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: path cannot map to a CMS filetype' tpath.ti
   exit 8
  end
  call findpath ename.ti
  if result>0 then do
   say 'GITWT: path is already mapped' tpath.ti
   exit 8
  end
  call findfile tfn.ti,tft.ti,'A'
  if result>0 then do
   say 'GITWT: CMS target is already mapped' tfn.ti tft.ti
   exit 8
  end
  'STATE' tfn.ti tft.ti 'A'
  if rc=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: CMS target already exists' tfn.ti tft.ti
   exit 8
  end
  if rc\=28 then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot inspect CMS target RC' rc
   exit 8
  end
  toid.ti=eoid.ti
  call readloose toid.ti
  if result\='OK' | readtype\='BLOB' then do
   say 'GITWT: checkout requires an available blob' toid.ti
   exit 8
  end
  call bodyrecords readhex
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: unsupported text workfile' tpath.ti
   exit 8
  end
  tlf.ti=final
  treccount.ti=rec.0
  do tj=1 to rec.0
   trecord.ti.tj=rec.tj
  end
  do tj=1 to ti-1
   if tfn.tj=tfn.ti & tft.tj=tft.ti then do
    say 'GITWT: Git paths collide as CMS file IDs'
    exit 8
   end
  end
 end
 drop before.
 'STATE GITWORK REPO A'
 beforeexists=0
 if rc=0 then do
  beforeexists=1
  'EXECIO * DISKR GITWORK REPO A 1 (STEM BEFORE. FINIS'
  if rc\=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot save prior worktree map'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 else if rc=28 then before.0=0
 else do
  say 'GITWT: cannot inspect prior worktree map RC' rc
  exit 8
 end
 written=0
 do ti=1 to treefiles
  drop rec.
  rec.0=treccount.ti
  do tj=1 to rec.0
   rec.tj=trecord.ti.tj
  end
  call writework tfn.ti,tft.ti,'A'
  if result\='OK' then do
   'ERASE' tfn.ti tft.ti 'A'
   do trb=1 to written
    'ERASE' tfn.trb tft.trb 'A'
   end
   exit 8
  end
  written=written+1
 end
 do ti=1 to treefiles
  mapcount=mapcount+1
  pi=mapcount
  mapfn.pi=tfn.ti
  mapft.pi=tft.ti
  mapfm.pi='A'
  maplf.pi=tlf.ti
  mapbase.pi=toid.ti
  mapstage.pi=toid.ti
  mappath.pi=ename.ti
 end
 call savemap
 if result\='OK' then do
  'STATE GITWORK REPO A'
  if rc=0 then 'ERASE GITWORK REPO A'
  if beforeexists then,
   'EXECIO' before.0 'DISKW GITWORK REPO A 1 (STEM BEFORE. FINIS'
  do trb=1 to written
   'ERASE' tfn.trb tft.trb 'A'
  end
  exit 8
 end
 do ti=1 to treefiles
  say 'CHECKED OUT' tpath.ti 'AS' tfn.ti tft.ti 'A'
  say 'WORKTREE OID' toid.ti 'FINAL-LF' tlf.ti
 end
 say 'CHECKED OUT TREE FILES' treefiles
 exit 0
end

if command='RESTORE-WORKTREE' then do
 restorewords=words(rest)
 restorestart=1
 restoresource=0
 sourcearg=''
 if translate(word(rest,1))='--SOURCE' then do
  restoresource=1
  sourcearg=word(rest,2)
  if sourcearg='' then do
   say 'Usage: GIT RESTORE --source revision --worktree [--] path...'
   exit 4
  end
  restorestart=3
 end
 if word(rest,restorestart)='--' then restorestart=restorestart+1
 else if left(word(rest,restorestart),1)='-' then do
  say 'Usage: GIT RESTORE --worktree [--] path [path ...]'
  exit 4
 end
 restorepaths=restorewords-restorestart+1
 if restorepaths<1 | restorepaths>16 then do
  say 'Usage: GIT RESTORE --worktree [--] path [path ...] (maximum 16 paths)'
  exit 4
 end
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 if mapcount=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: no mapped paths to restore'
  exit 4
 end
 sourcecommit=''
 if restoresource=1 then do
  call readrefs
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot read refs for restore source'
   exit 8
  end
  call resolve sourcearg
  sourcecommit=result
  if sourcecommit='ERROR' then exit 8
  call bindnative
  if result\='OK' then do
   say 'GITWT: cannot bind native source reader'
   exit 8
  end
 end
 zeros='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
 drop addpi. addpath. restorepi. restorebody. restorefinal.
 restorecount=0
 addcount=0
 do restorearg=restorestart to restorewords
  path=word(rest,restorearg)
  call toasciihex path
  pathhex=result
  if pathhex='ERROR' | length(pathhex)>60 then do
   say 'GITWT: invalid path' path
   exit 4
  end
  wildcard=0
  do restorewi=1 to length(pathhex) by 2
   if substr(pathhex,restorewi,2)='2A' |,
      substr(pathhex,restorewi,2)='3F' then wildcard=1
  end
  pathmatches=0
  if wildcard=0 then do
   call findpath pathhex
   restorepiindex=result
   if restorepiindex>0 then do
    pathmatches=1
    call asciitocms mappath.restorepiindex
    if result='ERROR' then do
     say 'GITWT: invalid mapped path' mappath.restorepiindex
     exit 8
    end
    call addselected restorepiindex,result
   end
  end
  else do
   do restorepiindex=1 to mapcount
    call matchpath pathhex,mappath.restorepiindex
    if result=1 then do
     pathmatches=pathmatches+1
     call asciitocms mappath.restorepiindex
     if result='ERROR' then do
      say 'GITWT: invalid mapped path' mappath.restorepiindex
      exit 8
     end
     call addselected restorepiindex,result
    end
   end
  end
  if pathmatches=0 then do
   say 'GITWT: pathspec did not match any checked out path' path
   exit 4
  end
 end
 restorecount=addcount
 headcommit=''
 do restorearg=1 to restorecount
  restorepi.restorearg=addpi.restorearg
  pi=restorepi.restorearg
  restoreoldlf.restorearg=maplf.pi
  'STATE' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
  if rc=0 then do
   restoreexists.restorearg=1
   drop restoreold.
   'EXECIO * DISKR' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi '1 (STEM RESTOREOLD. FINIS'
   if rc\=0 then do
    say 'GITWT: cannot snapshot restore target' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
    exit 8
   end
   restoreoldcount.restorearg=restoreold.0
   do restoreline=1 to restoreold.0
    restoreoldline.restorearg.restoreline=restoreold.restoreline
   end
  end
  else if rc=28 then do
   restoreexists.restorearg=0
   restoreoldcount.restorearg=0
  end
  else do
   say 'GITWT: cannot inspect restore target RC' rc
   exit 8
  end
  if restoresource=0 & mapstage.pi=zeros then do
   restoretarget.restorearg=zeros
   restorefinal.restorearg=maplf.pi
   restorebody.restorearg='DELETE'
  end
  else do
   if restoresource=1 then do
    call pathoidfor sourcecommit,mappath.pi
    if result='ERROR' then do
     say 'GITWT: source path is absent or cannot be read' sourcearg,
         mappath.pi
     exit 8
    end
    restoretarget.restorearg=pathoid
    restorebody.restorearg=body
   end
   else if mapstage.pi=mapbase.pi & mapbase.pi\=zeros then do
    if headcommit='' then do
     call readrefs
     if result\='OK' then exit 8
     call resolve 'HEAD'
     headcommit=result
     if headcommit='ERROR' then exit 8
     call bindnative
     if result\='OK' then exit 8
    end
    call pathoidfor headcommit,mappath.pi
    if result='ERROR' | pathoid\=mapstage.pi then do
     say 'GITWT: staged base blob does not match current HEAD' mapfn.pi
     exit 8
    end
    restorebody.restorearg=body
    restoretarget.restorearg=pathoid
   end
   else do
    call readrestoreblob mapstage.pi
    restorebody.restorearg=result
    if result='ERROR' then do
     say 'GITWT: cannot read staged blob' mapstage.pi
     exit 8
    end
    restoretarget.restorearg=mapstage.pi
   end
   call bodyrecords restorebody.restorearg
   if result\='OK' then exit 8
   restorefinal.restorearg=final
   restorelinecount.restorearg=rec.0
   do restoreline=1 to rec.0
    restoreline.restorearg.restoreline=rec.restoreline
   end
  end
 end
 'STATE GITWORK REPO A'
 if rc\=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot snapshot worktree map'
  exit 8
 end
 drop before.
 'EXECIO * DISKR GITWORK REPO A 1 (STEM BEFORE. FINIS'
 if rc\=0 then do
  say 'GITWT: cannot snapshot worktree map'
  exit 8
 end
 do restorearg=1 to restorecount
  pi=restorepi.restorearg
  if restorebody.restorearg='DELETE' then do
   if restoreexists.restorearg=1 then do
    'ERASE' mapfn.pi mapft.pi mapfm.pi
    if rc\=0 then do
     call rollbackrestore
     say 'GITWT: workfile delete failed; restore rollback RC' result
     exit 8
    end
   end
  end
  else do
   drop rec.
   rec.0=restorelinecount.restorearg
   do restoreline=1 to rec.0
    rec.restoreline=restoreline.restorearg.restoreline
   end
   call writework mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi
   if result\='OK' then do
    call rollbackrestore
    say 'GITWT: workfile write failed; restore rollback RC' result
    exit 8
   end
   call workoid mapfn.pi,mapft.pi,mapfm.pi,restorefinal.restorearg,0
   if result\=restoretarget.restorearg then do
    call rollbackrestore
    say 'GITWT: workfile verification failed; restore rollback RC' result
    exit 8
   end
  end
 end
 mapchanged=0
 do restorearg=1 to restorecount
  pi=restorepi.restorearg
  if restorebody.restorearg\='DELETE' then do
   if maplf.pi\=restorefinal.restorearg then mapchanged=1
   maplf.pi=restorefinal.restorearg
  end
 end
 if mapchanged=1 then do
  call savemap
  if result\='OK' then do
   do restorearg=1 to restorecount
    pi=restorepi.restorearg
    maplf.pi=restoreoldlf.restorearg
   end
   call restoremap
   maprc=result
   call rollbackrestore
   say 'GITWT: map save failed; restore rollback RC' maprc result
   exit 8
  end
 end
 do restorearg=1 to restorecount
  pi=restorepi.restorearg
  call asciitocms mappath.pi
  path=result
  if restorebody.restorearg='DELETE' then,
   say 'RESTORED WORKTREE DELETION' path
  else if restoresource=1 then,
   say 'RESTORED WORKTREE' path restoretarget.restorearg 'FROM' sourcearg
  else say 'RESTORED WORKTREE' path mapstage.pi
 end
 exit 0
end

if command='STATUS' then do
 shortstatus=0
 statusbranch=0
 statuswords=words(rest)
 statusstart=statuswords+1
 statussep=0
 do si=1 to statuswords
  statusopt=translate(word(rest,si))
  if statusopt='--' then do
   statusstart=si+1
   statussep=1
   leave
  end
  else if statusopt='--SHORT' | statusopt='--PORCELAIN' then,
   shortstatus=1
  else if statusopt='--BRANCH' then statusbranch=1
  else do
   if left(statusopt,1)='-' then do
    say 'Usage: GIT STATUS [--short|--porcelain] [--branch] [--] [path ...]'
    exit 4
   end
   statusstart=si
   leave
  end
 end
 statuspaths=statuswords-statusstart+1
 if statuspaths<0 then statuspaths=0
 if statuspaths>16 | (statussep=1 & statuspaths=0) then do
  say 'Usage: GIT STATUS [--short|--porcelain] [--branch] [--] paths'
  say '(maximum 16 pathspecs)'
  exit 4
 end
 if statusbranch=1 then do
  call readrefs
  if result\='OK' then exit 8
  branchname=substr(headref,12)
  if shortstatus=1 then say '##' branchname
  else say 'On branch' branchname
 end
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 if mapcount=0 then do
  if statuspaths>0 then do
   say 'GITWT: pathspec did not match a checked out path',
       word(rest,statusstart)
   exit 4
  end
  if shortstatus=0 then say 'STATUS NO TRACKED FILES'
  exit 0
 end
 drop statusselected.
 statusselectedcount=0
 if statuspaths=0 then do
  do si=1 to mapcount
   statusselected.si=1
  end
  statusselectedcount=mapcount
 end
 else do
  do si=statusstart to statuswords
   path=word(rest,si)
   call toasciihex path
   pathhex=result
   if pathhex='ERROR' | length(pathhex)>60 then do
    say 'GITWT: invalid path' path
    exit 4
   end
   wildcard=0
   do wi=1 to length(pathhex) by 2
    if substr(pathhex,wi,2)='2A' | substr(pathhex,wi,2)='3F' then,
     wildcard=1
   end
   pathmatches=0
   if wildcard=0 then do
    call findpath pathhex
    pi=result
    if pi>0 then do
     pathmatches=1
     if statusselected.pi\=1 then do
      statusselected.pi=1
      statusselectedcount=statusselectedcount+1
     end
    end
   end
   else do
    do pi=1 to mapcount
     call matchpath pathhex,mappath.pi
     if result=1 then do
      pathmatches=pathmatches+1
      if statusselected.pi\=1 then do
       statusselected.pi=1
       statusselectedcount=statusselectedcount+1
      end
     end
    end
   end
   if pathmatches=0 then do
    say 'GITWT: pathspec did not match any checked out path' path
    exit 4
   end
  end
 end
 changed=0
 staged=0
 zeros='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
 do i=1 to mapcount
  if statusselected.i\=1 then iterate
  call asciitocms mappath.i
  p=result
  if p='ERROR' then exit 8
  'STATE' mapfn.i mapft.i mapfm.i
  if rc=28 then do
   work=zeros
   if mapstage.i=zeros then state='CLEAN'
   else do
    state='DELETED'
    changed=changed+1
   end
   if mapstage.i\=mapbase.i then staged=staged+1
  end
  else if rc\=0 then exit 8
  else do
   call workoid mapfn.i,mapft.i,mapfm.i,maplf.i,0
   work=result
   if work='ERROR' then exit 8
   if work=mapstage.i then do
    if mapstage.i=mapbase.i then state='CLEAN'
    else do
     state='STAGED'
     staged=staged+1
    end
   end
   else do
    changed=changed+1
    if mapstage.i=zeros then state='ADDED'
    else if mapstage.i=mapbase.i then state='MODIFIED'
    else do
     state='STAGED+MODIFIED'
     staged=staged+1
    end
   end
  end
  if shortstatus=1 then do
   x=' '
   y=' '
   if mapstage.i\=mapbase.i then do
    if mapstage.i=zeros then x='D'
    else if mapbase.i=zeros then x='A'
    else x='M'
   end
   if state='DELETED' then y='D'
   else if state='MODIFIED' | state='STAGED+MODIFIED' then y='M'
   else if state='ADDED' then y='A'
   if x\=' ' | y\=' ' then say x||y||' '||p
  end
  else do
   say 'STATUS' p state
   say 'BASE' mapbase.i
   say 'STAGE' mapstage.i
   say 'WORK' work
  end
 end
 if shortstatus=0 then say 'STATUS SUMMARY TRACKED' statusselectedcount,
     'CHANGED' changed 'STAGED' staged
 exit 0
end

if command='DIFF' then do
 diffarg1=translate(word(rest,1))
 diffarg2=translate(word(rest,2))
 cached=0
 if diffarg1='--CACHED' | diffarg1='--STAGED' then do
  if words(rest)\=2 | diffarg2\='--NAME-ONLY' then do
   say 'Usage: GIT DIFF [--cached|--staged] --name-only'
   exit 4
  end
  cached=1
 end
 else if words(rest)\=1 | diffarg1\='--NAME-ONLY' then do
  say 'Usage: GIT DIFF [--cached|--staged] --name-only'
  exit 4
 end
 call loadmap
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 zeros='0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'
 do i=1 to mapcount
  changed=0
  if cached=1 then do
   if mapstage.i\=mapbase.i then changed=1
  end
  else do
   'STATE' mapfn.i mapft.i mapfm.i
   if rc=28 then do
    if mapstage.i\=zeros then changed=1
   end
   else if rc\=0 then exit 8
   else do
    call workoid mapfn.i,mapft.i,mapfm.i,maplf.i,0
    work=result
    if work='ERROR' then exit 8
    if work\=mapstage.i then changed=1
   end
  end
  if changed=1 then do
   call asciitocms mappath.i
   path=result
   if path='ERROR' then exit 8
   say path
  end
 end
 exit 0
end

/* M273: apply a clean fast-forward with an unchanged flat path set. */
if command='CHECK-PULL' | command='APPLY-PULL' then do
 parse var rest pullbranch pullold pullnew extra
 pullref='refs/heads/'||pullbranch
 if pullbranch='' | pullold='' | pullnew='' | extra\='' then do
  say 'Usage: GITWT CHECK-PULL|APPLY-PULL branch old-commit new-commit'
  exit 4
 end
 call validref pullref
 if result\='OK' then exit 4
 pullold=translate(pullold)
 pullnew=translate(pullnew)
 if length(pullold)\=40 | length(pullnew)\=40 |,
    verify(pullold,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 |,
    verify(pullnew,'0123456789ABCDEF')\=0 | pullold=pullnew then exit 4
 call readrefs
 if result\='OK' | headref\=pullref then do
  say 'GITWT: current branch changed before pull'
  exit 8
 end
 foundref=0
 currentoid=''
 do ri=1 to refcount
  if refname.ri=pullref then do
   foundref=foundref+1
   currentoid=refoid.ri
  end
 end
 if foundref\=1 then exit 8
 if command='CHECK-PULL' & currentoid\=pullold then do
  say 'GITWT: local branch tip changed before pull preflight'
  exit 8
 end
 if command='APPLY-PULL' & currentoid\=pullnew then do
  say 'GITWT: local branch tip changed before pull apply'
  exit 8
 end
 call preflightpull
 if result\='OK' then exit 8
 if command='CHECK-PULL' then do
  say 'PULL PREFLIGHT SAFE MAPPED' mapcount
  exit 0

#!/bin/bash
set -u

HOST=127.0.0.1
PORT=3271
FILEMODE=A
BUFFER=2048
MAXTRIES=3

action()
{
    printf '%s\n' "$1" | nc "$HOST" "$PORT"
}

upload()
{
    local localfile="$1"
    local base cmsname cmstype result try

    if [ ! -f "$localfile" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: file not found: $localfile" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    base=$(basename "$localfile")

    case "$base" in
        *.*)
            cmsname=${base%%.*}
            cmstype=${base#*.}
            ;;
        *)
            echo "ERROR: filename must be NAME.TYPE: $localfile" >&2
            return 1
            ;;
    esac

    cmsname=$(printf '%s' "$cmsname" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')
    cmstype=$(printf '%s' "$cmstype" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')

    if [ ${#cmsname} -gt 8 ] || [ ${#cmstype} -gt 8 ]; then
        echo "ERROR: CMS name/type exceeds 8 characters: $cmsname $cmstype" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    try=1
    while [ "$try" -le "$MAXTRIES" ]; do
        echo "=== $localfile -> $cmsname $cmstype $FILEMODE (attempt $try/$MAXTRIES) ==="

        result=$(
            action "Transfer(Direction=send,\"HostFile=$cmsname $cmstype $FILEMODE\",LocalFile=$localfile,Host=vm,Mode=ascii,Exist=replace,Recfm=fixed,Lrecl=80,BufferSize=$BUFFER)"
        )

        printf '%s\n' "$result"

        if printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -q '^ok$'; then
            return 0
        fi

        echo "Transfer failed; recovering c3270 screen before retry..."

        action 'Clear()' >/dev/null
        sleep 2

        try=$((try + 1))
    done

    echo "ERROR: transfer failed after $MAXTRIES attempts: $localfile" >&2
    return 1
}

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 file [file ...]" >&2
    echo "Example: $0 GIT.EXEC GITREF.EXEC M5REFS.EXEC" >&2
    exit 2
fi

for file in "$@"; do
    if ! upload "$file"; then
        echo
        echo "CMS upload FAILED."
        exit 1
    fi
done

echo
echo "CMS upload complete."
